description:
Find comfortable and modern living in the heart of Raheny, Dublin 5. Occu Owenmore's 1 and 2 bedroom apartments are designed with thoughtful details, stylish finishes, and your everyday ease in mind. Just 50 metres from the DART and minutes from the buzz of Raheny Village, you'll have the best of city and coastal living right on your doorstep. Whether it's a morning walk in St. Anne's Park or a short commute to the Docklands, life flows effortlessly at Occu Owenmore.

Please note: BER's range from A2-A3
